mapper.select: /* TITLENAME:标题名(普通产品取产品名称 ,分级产品取 母产品名称+（子产品代码）) PRODNAME：产品名称（普通产品取产品名称 ,分级产品取母产品名称） PRODID：产品代码（普通产品取产品代码 ,分级产品取子产品代码） REGCODE：产品登记编码（普通产品取产品登记编码 ,分级产品取母产品登记编码） */ SELECT RPI.PROD_ID prodId, CASE WHEN RPI.IS_GRADE = '01' THEN RPI2.PROD_NAME ||'（'||RPI.PROD_ID||'）' ELSE RPI.PROD_NAME END titleName, CASE WHEN RPI.IS_GRADE = '01' THEN RPI2.PROD_NAME ||RPI.PROD_NAME ELSE RPI.PROD_NAME END prodName, NVL(RPI2.PROD_RE,RPI.PROD_RE) regCode FROM REP_PROD_INFO RPI LEFT JOIN REP_PROD_INFO RPI2 ON RPI.P_PROD_ID = RPI2.PROD_ID AND RPI2.STATUS = 'E' WHERE RPI.PROD_ID = #{prodId} AND RPI.STATUS = 'E'

SELECT TO_CHAR(T.VALUE_DATE,'yyyy-MM-dd') valueDate, TO_CHAR(NVL(T.W_YIELD,0),'FM9999999999999999.0000') wYield, TO_CHAR(ROUND(NVL(T.YIELD_7,0) * 100,4),'FM9999999999999999.0000') yield7 , '1.0000' unitValue, '1.0000' unitValueT, '1.0000' subValue, '1.0000' redValue FROM REP_PROD_INFO INFO INNER JOIN REP_PROD_INDEX PRI ON PRI.PROD_ID = NVL(INFO.P_PROD_ID,INFO.PROD_ID) AND PRI.STATUS = 'E' WHERE INFO.PROD_ID = #{prodId} AND PRI.VALUE_DATE <= #{edate} AND PRI.VALUE_DATE >= #{vdate} ORDER BY PRI.VALUE_DATE DESC

SELECT TO_CHAR(T.VALUE_DATE,'yyyy-MM-dd') valueDate, TO_CHAR(NVL(T.W_YIELD,0),'FM9999999999999999.0000') wYield, TO_CHAR(ROUND(NVL(T.YIELD_7,0) * 100,4),'FM9999999999999999.0000') yield7 , '1.0000' unitValue, '1.0000' unitValueT, '1.0000' subValue, '1.0000' redValue FROM REP_PROD_INFO INFO INNER JOIN REP_PROD_INDEX PRI ON PRI.PROD_ID = NVL(INFO.P_PROD_ID,INFO.PROD_ID) AND PRI.STATUS = 'E' WHERE INFO.PROD_ID = #{prodId} AND PRI.VALUE_DATE = TO_DATE(#{valueDate},'yyyy-MM-dd') ORDER BY PRI.VALUE_DATE DESC

TO_CHAR(NVL(PRI.UNIT_VALUE,0),'FM9999999999999999.0000') value, TO_CHAR(NVL(PRI.UNIT_VALUE_T,0),'FM9999999999999999.0000') totalValue
